authorInfo.bio: G. K. (Gilbert Keith) Chesterton (1874–1936) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include The Man Who Was Thursday: A Nightmare, The innocence of Father Brown, The secret of Father Brown, The wisdom of Father Brown, The Ballad of the White Horse. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.
